items.originalTitle: Carlos Sainz's "Smooth Operator" lounge returns for F1 Las Vegas GP
detailZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯的“Smooth Operator”休息室回归F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛
卡洛斯·塞恩斯的“Smooth Operator”休息室将回归2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛，作为MGM度假村揭晓一系列F1主题活动的标志。
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
卡洛斯·塞恩斯的“Smooth Operator”休息室将回归下个月的拉斯维加斯大奖赛，作为MGM度假村在其四家酒店中公布赛事周计划的一部分。
休息室回归ARIA， Proper Eats餐厅将被改造成赛恩斯主题空间，出售定制服装和基于威廉姆斯车手风格的鸡尾酒。这位西班牙人也将亲自亮相。
"随着拉斯维加斯大奖赛回归第四年，我们正专注于MGM度假村最擅长的事情——将令人难以置信的体育、奢华酒店服务和娱乐活动结合在一起，"MGM度假村娱乐部总裁Ryan Abboushi说。
“通过我们与顶级全球品牌的合作，我们的度假村将在拉斯维加斯大道上为来自世界各地的赛车粉丝提供他们别处找不到的体验。
在贝拉吉奥、ARIA、科斯莫波利坦和公园MGM举办的其它活动包括在科斯莫波利坦展示哈斯F1车队展示车和纪念品，贝拉吉奥的法拉利精品店，科斯莫波利坦的布洛维德大道派对甲板，以及贝拉吉奥的Shoey酒吧等。
拉斯维加斯大奖赛定于11月19日至21日举行，标志着2026赛季最后一场三连赛的开始。
在2026年6月合同延期后，围绕拉斯维加斯市区街道的比赛将保留在F1赛历上直至2037年底。
"我们对F1将继续在拉斯维加斯举办多年感到非常兴奋，" F1首席执行官斯蒂法诺·多梅尼卡利在宣布时表示。
"自2023年首次亮相以来，这一赛事就非常出色，迅速成为顶级赛车、世界级娱乐、全球商业领袖、一线明星和影响者首选的目的地。"
“它对当地经济和社区产生了强大而持久的影响。我们一直相信拉斯维加斯将成为我们在美国的基石，这次扩展，加上近年来取得的成功，进一步强化了我们对这个重要市场的长期承诺。”
detailEn: Carlos Sainz's "Smooth Operator" lounge returns for F1 Las Vegas GP
Carlos Sainz's "Smooth Operator" lounge will return to the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix as MGM Resorts unveils a range of F1-themed events
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Carlos Sainz's "Smooth Operator" lounge is coming back to the Las Vegas Strip for next month's Las Vegas Grand Prix, as MGM Resorts revealed its race-week plans across four of its hotels.

The lounge returns to ARIA, where the Proper Eats restaurant will be turned into a Sainz-themed space selling custom clothing and cocktails based on the Williams driver's style. The Spaniard is also due to make an appearance himself.

"With the Las Vegas Grand Prix back for year four, we are focusing on what MGM Resorts does best – bringing together incredible sports, luxury hospitality and entertainment," said Ryan Abboushi, MGM Resorts’ president of entertainment.
"Through our partnerships with top global brands, our resorts along The Strip are set to provide race fans from all over the world with an experience they won't find anywhere else."

Other events held at the Bellagio, ARIA, The Cosmopolitan and Park MGM include a Haas F1 team show car and memorabilia display at The Cosmopolitan, the Ferrari boutique at Bellagio, the Boulevard Party Deck at The Cosmopolitan, and the Shoey Bar at Bellagio, among others.
The Las Vegas Grand Prix is scheduled for 19-21 November and kicks off the final triple-header of the 2026 season.
The race around the streets of Sin City will remain on the Formula 1 calendar through to the end of 2037 following a contract extension in June 2026.
"We are thrilled that Formula 1 will continue racing in Las Vegas for many years to come," F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali said at the time of the announcement.

"Since its debut in 2023, the event has been extraordinary, rapidly establishing itself as a premier destination for great racing, world-class entertainment, global business leaders, A-list celebrities and influencers.

"It has delivered a strong and lasting impact on the local economy and community. We always believed that Las Vegas would become a cornerstone of our presence in the United States, and this extension, together with the success of recent years, reinforces our long-term commitment to this important market."
keyPointsZh: 休息室将位于ARIA酒店， Proper Eats餐厅将变成塞恩斯主题空间
keyPointsEn: The lounge will be located at the ARIA hotel with Proper Eats restaurant transformed into a Sainz-themed space

items.originalTitle: TAG Heuer unveils special edition Red Bull F1 watch for 10-year celebration
detailZh: 泰格豪雅推出庆祝10周年纪念版红牛一级方程式手表
泰格豪雅推出一款特别版一级方程式太阳图形手表，以庆祝其与红牛赛车队的10年合作
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
泰格豪雅推出了一款特别版的一级方程式太阳图形手表，以庆祝其作为红牛一级方程式车队合作伙伴的10周年。
F1 Solargraph x Oracle 红牛 Racing售价为1900英镑（约合2250美元）。美国买家于10月20日提前获得了在线购买权限，这比本周末在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举行的美国大奖赛还要早。
这款手表的颜色灵感来源于米尔顿凯恩斯车队的外观。它拥有深蓝色的太阳光刷面表盘，白色的时针和分针，以及黄色的秒针，这些都设置在一个由TAG Heuer的TH-Polylight材料制成的蓝色双向表圈中。
TAG Heuer首席执行官贝阿特丽斯·戈亚斯格拉斯说：“十年前，TAG Heuer和Oracle 红牛 Racing基于一个简单的信念走到一起：每一秒的每一部分都很重要。从那时起，我们分享了领奖台、冠军头衔和相同的无休止的获胜动力。”
这款特别版手表庆祝了这段旅程，同时坚定地向前看。它拥有38毫米的表壳和Solargraph机芯，将赛道的能量带给新一代的钟表爱好者，对他们来说，赛车不仅是运动，也是一种文化。这是‘专为胜利设计’所代表的一切。
泰格豪雅自2016年起成为红牛一级方程式车队的官方计时员、官方手表和团队性能合作伙伴。
红牛车队在美国大奖赛上以332分排在车队积分榜第四位，落后积分榜领跑者梅赛德斯246分。车队还带着在马来西亚巴林大奖赛和新加坡大奖赛上连续两次获胜的势头。
维斯塔潘在车手积分榜上排名第四，积分为221分，他的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第八，积分为97分。
美国大奖赛将于10月23日至25日在美国赛车场举行。
detailEn: TAG Heuer unveils special edition Red Bull F1 watch for 10-year celebration
TAG Heuer has unveiled a special edition Formula 1 Solargraph watch celebrating its 10-year partnership with Red Bull Racing
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
TAG Heuer has released a special edition of its Formula 1 Solargraph watch to celebrate 10 years as a partner of the Red Bull F1 team.

The Formula 1 Solargraph x Oracle Red Bull Racing costs £1900 (approximately $2250). Buyers based in America were given early online access on 20 October, ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix in Austin, Texas.

The watch takes its colours from the Milton Keynes outfit's livery. It has a deep blue sunray-brushed dial, white hour and minute hands and a yellow seconds hand, set inside a blue bidirectional bezel made from TAG Heuer's TH-Polylight material.

"Ten years ago, TAG Heuer and Oracle Red Bull Racing came together around a simple conviction: every fraction of a second matters. Since then, we have shared podiums, titles and the same relentless drive to win," TAG Heuer CEO Béatrice Goasglas said.

"This special edition celebrates that journey while looking firmly ahead. With its 38 mm case and Solargraph movement, it brings the energy of the grid to a new generation of watch enthusiasts, for whom racing is as much a culture as a sport. It is everything ‘Designed to Win’ stands for."
TAG Heuer has been a partner of the Red Bull F1 team as official timekeeper, official watch and team performance partner since 2016.

Red Bull heads into the United States Grand Prix fourth in the constructors' standings with 332 points, 246 points behind championship leader Mercedes. It also carries the momentum of back-to-back wins with Max Verstappen at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia and the Singapore Grand Prix.
Verstappen sits fourth in the drivers' standings with 221 points, and his team-mate Isack Hadjar is eighth with 97 points.
The United States Grand Prix is scheduled to take place at the Circuit of the Americas from 23-25 October.

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris risks unwanted F1 record as disastrous title defence continues
items.summaryEn: After winning the 2025 Formula 1 world championship, Lando Norris is enduring a poor title defence and currently sits sixth in the drivers' standings on 201 points with six races remaining. If he finishes sixth or lower, he would become the first reigning champion since Damon Hill in 1997 to end the following season outside the top five.
detailZh: 诺里斯卫冕赛季表现糟糕，恐创下不受欢迎的F1纪录
诺里斯可能成为自1997年达蒙·希尔以来，首位在卫冕赛季跌出前五的F1世界冠军
在赢得2025年F1世界冠军并永远将自己的名字写入史册之后，诺里斯正在经历这项锦标赛历史上最糟糕的卫冕赛季之一。
这位英国车手目前仅积201分，位列车手积分榜第六，本赛季还剩六站比赛。如果他最终排名第六或更低，他将成为自1997年达蒙·希尔以来首位在夺冠后的下一个赛季跌出前五的卫冕冠军。
希尔在1996年随威廉姆斯车队赢得总冠军，但随后被车队放弃，转投飞箭车队，在1997年获得第12名。自那以后，卫冕冠军最差的年终排名是第五名。
1998年：雅克·维伦纽夫，威廉姆斯车队，第五名
可以说，尼科·罗斯伯格在2016年成为总冠军后因退役而未能卫冕，但我不确定这算不算数。
诺里斯目前仅落后排名第五的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔14分，落后排名第四的马克斯·维斯塔潘20分。因此，尽管本赛季已无冲刺赛周末，诺里斯仍有可能摆脱这一低迷状态。但前提是迈凯伦能在为时已晚之前改进赛车。
“赛车速度不够快，而且太难驾驶了。我们差得很远，”他在新加坡大奖赛获得第四名后对媒体表示。
“你必须始终着眼于整体套件，你知道吗？”车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉说。“我想我们知道，在长直道赛道上，我们表现并不太好。这套套件在这些赛道上不够强。
“所以像巴库、蒙扎、拉斯维加斯这样的赛道会很困难。赛车在低速、非常小且紧的弯角里，当你必须踩刹车时……这类情况下表现很强。我觉得它相当不错，但还不是最好的，所以我们需要在这方面努力。你知道它有优势，也有弱点，在赛季剩余时间里会有起伏。”
detailEn: Lando Norris risks unwanted F1 record as disastrous title defence continues
Lando Norris risks becoming the first reigning Formula 1 world champion since Damon Hill in 1997 to finish his title defence outside the top five
After winning the 2025 Formula 1 championship and forever solidifying his name in the history books, Lando Norris is putting together one of the worst title defences the championship has ever seen.

The Briton currently sits sixth in the drivers' standings on just 201 points with six races to go. If he finishes sixth or lower, he will be the first reigning champion to finish outside the top five the following season since Damon Hill in 1997.
Hill won the title with Williams in 1996, but was dropped by the team and moved to Arrows, finishing 12th in 1997. Since then, the worst a reigning champion has finished is fifth.
1998: Jacques Villeneuve, Williams, fifth
Arguably, Nico Rosberg failed to defend his title after becoming champion in 2016 due to his retirement, but I'm not sure that counts.

Norris is only 14 points behind Ferrari's Charles Leclerc, who sits in fifth, and 20 points behind Max Verstappen in fourth. So even though there are no sprint race weekends left this season, it's still possible for Norris to pull himself out of this slump. But that's if McLaren can improve the car before it's too late.
"The car's not quick enough and it's too difficult to drive. We're a long way off," he told the media after he finished fourth at the Singapore Grand Prix.

"You have to always look at the package, you know?" team principal Andrea Stella said. "I think we know that tracks with long straights, we are not that great. The package is not strong in these circuits.

"So tracks like Baku, like Monza, like Las Vegas will be difficult. The the car is strong in low speed, in very small tight, little corners when you have to be on brakes... these kind of things. I think it's quite good, but it's not the best so we need to work on that. You know it has strength, it has weaknesses and it will go up and down for the rest of the season."
keyPointsEn: Six races remain in the season

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris launches new clothing collection ahead of United States Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: McLaren driver Lando Norris has launched a new clothing collection from his LN4 brand ahead of the United States Grand Prix, inspired by 1970s racing garages, and turned an old Austin fuel station into a pop-up store to showcase the new products.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯在美国大奖赛前推出新服装系列
兰多·诺里斯推出了一个全新的12件服装系列，灵感来自1970年代的赛车车库
致迈凯伦车迷。来自沃金的木瓜色新闻，带来车手、赛车、车队策略以及每个比赛周末的最新消息。
迈凯伦车手兰多·诺里斯在美国大奖赛前推出了一条新的服装线。受1970年代赛车车库启发，他把奥斯汀一座旧加油站改造成快闪店，用来展示他的新产品。
Lando 的 Original Service Department 是他 LN4 品牌的一个 12 件单品系列，涵盖工装风格服装、T 恤和男女通用帽子。如果这让你感兴趣，而且你本周末在奥斯汀观看大奖赛，可以前往奥斯汀市中心圣哈辛托大道 1500 号，浏览现有商品。
该店于周三开业，周四至周日营业时间为上午 9 点至晚上 7 点。
如果这还不够，你还可以借助迈凯伦赞助商 Google Gemini 定制明信片或徽章。
诺里斯的另一个品牌 Quadrant 本周早些时候也在奥斯汀举办了快闪活动。
这套收藏让这位英国人在艰难的卫冕赛季中有了值得庆祝的东西。这位卫冕世界冠军以201分位列积分榜第六，落后领先者基米·安东内利139分，他驾驶的迈凯伦赛车被他形容为“精神上令人疲惫”。这支来自沃金的车队是卫冕车队冠军，目前在积分榜上排名第三，领先复苏的红牛七分。
“每个弯道都像在刀尖上，”诺里斯在新加坡站后说道。“你必须在精确的百分比内驾驶，而且你必须以各种方式强行驾驭赛车。你不能让赛车自己去做任何工作。你不能只让前部工作或只让后部工作。
“你必须强行控制前部，强行控制后部，你必须以一种需要高度集中和极强能力的方式驾驶它。这完全是全力以赴，而且精神上令人疲惫，因为你在方向盘后面必须付出多么大的努力，所以这实在太难了，这使得在排位赛中做出完整的圈速变得不可能，这恰恰说明了当我们拿到杆位之类的时候我们能够做得有多好，以及那种感觉有多值得。
“但现在它不够快，就只是……太难了，你无法做出任何神奇的事情，因为你根本不够快。所以只是……你必须强行驾驭赛车，你不能让赛车自己去做任何工作，因为它不会自己去做，而这完全不是你想要的赛车。”
detailEn: Lando Norris launches new clothing collection ahead of United States Grand Prix
Lando Norris has launched a new 12-piece clothing collection inspired by 1970s racing garages
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

McLaren driver Lando Norris has launched a new clothing line ahead of the United States Grand Prix. Inspired by 1970s racing garages, he's turned an old Austin fuel station into a pop-up to show off his new products.

Lando's Original Service Department is a 12-piece collection from his LN4 brand, which covers workwear-style clothing, T-shirts and caps for both sexes. If that tickles your fancy and you're in Austin this weekend for the grand prix, head to 1500 San Jacinto Boulevard in downtown Austin and you will be able to browse through what's available.
It opened on the Wednesday and is open from 9am to 7pm from Thursday to Sunday.
If that's not enough, you can even get a custom postcard or patch made thanks to McLaren sponsor Google Gemini.
Norris’s other brand, Quadrant, also held a pop-up in Austin earlier in the week.

The collection gives the Briton something to celebrate during a difficult title defence. The reigning world champion is sixth in the standings on 201 points, 139 behind leader Kimi Antonelli, in a McLaren he calls "mentally draining" to drive. The Woking outfit, the reigning constructors’ champion, is third in the standings, seven points ahead of a resurgent Red Bull.

"It's just on a knife edge on every single corner," Norris said after the Singapore race. "Just got to drive it within an exact percent and you have to force the car in every single way. You can't let the car do any work. You can't just let the front do the work or the rear do the work.

"You have to force the front, you got to force the rear, you got to drive it in a way that takes so much concentration and so much ability. It's just full on and mentally draining because of how hard you have to work behind the wheel so it's just too difficult and it makes it impossible to put laps together in qualifying which just show how good of a job we were able to do when we were getting on pole and things like that and how rewarding that felt.

"But with it not being quick enough now it's just... it's too difficult and you can't do anything magical because you're simply not quick enough. So it's just... you have to force the car and you can't let the car do any work because it doesn't do it on its own and that's not what you want from a car at all."
keyPointsZh: 该系列名为Lando's Original Service Department，共12件单品，包括工装风格服装、T恤和男女款帽子。
keyPointsEn: The collection, called Lando's Original Service Department, has 12 pieces, including workwear-style clothing, T-shirts and caps for both sexes.

items.summaryEn: Antonelli could clinch the drivers' championship at this weekend's United States Grand Prix, and he revealed that he still washes his own car by hand.
detailZh: 安东内利有望加冕仍坚持自己洗车
梅赛德斯车手安东内利透露，他仍坚持亲手洗车。
致梅赛德斯车迷：来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
安东内利本周末有望加冕F1车手总冠军，但在讲述自己赛道之外如何度过时间时，他透露自己仍坚持亲手洗车。
这位梅赛德斯车手抵达奥斯汀时，领先队友乔治·拉塞尔102分，并有机会在本周末的美国大奖赛上锁定车手总冠军。这将使他成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，也是自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来首位夺得该头衔的意大利人。
在梅赛德斯美国大奖赛特别涂装发布活动上，这位20岁的车手表示，他在家的日常安排包括清洗自己的梅赛德斯-AMG GT63公路跑车。
“我喜欢洗我的车，”安东内利说。“我从来不用自动洗车机，你知道的，那种机器。我总是喜欢自己动手洗。因为我热爱汽车，我真的很喜欢打理我的车和一切。
“我喜欢看到它干干净净的，所以这是我热爱做的一件事。这是一种日常习惯。”
在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举行的美国大奖赛，拉开了2026赛季倒数第二个三连赛的序幕。梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫认为，在美洲赛道举行的这个周末，将给这支位于布拉克利的车队一个机会，在经历了马来西亚和新加坡两个艰难的周末后做出“回应”。
“马来西亚和新加坡对我们来说是艰难的周末，我们已经努力去理解我们在哪里做得不够好，”沃尔夫在车队的美国大奖赛前瞻中表示。“奥斯汀给了我们一个做出回应的机会。”
“我们将在两辆车上运行最新的升级套件，同时继续研发赛车。竞争格局非常接近，所以如果我们想在赛季最后阶段持续在前方竞争，就需要不断向前推进。”
“美国大奖赛开启了又一个要求很高的三连赛。有很多利害攸关的事情，但我们不会好高骛远。优先事项是眼前的这个周末：执行到位，最大化我们的表现，一场一场地应对每场比赛。”
“奥斯汀对我们来说也将是一个重要的场外周末，全市将举办多项商业活动。其中的核心将是AMG和MANUFAKTUR的接管，在整个周末展现更广泛的梅赛德斯家族的卓越性能、精湛工艺和个性。我们期待展示这一点，并最终在最重要的地方——赛道上——交出答卷。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli reveals down-to-earth habit ahead of potential F1 title win
Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli has revealed that he still washes his own car by hand
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Kimi Antonelli could be crowned Formula 1 champion this weekend, but while explaining how he spends his time away from the track, he revealed that he still washes his own car by hand.

The Mercedes driver arrived in Austin with a 102-point lead over his team-mate George Russell and has the opportunity to claim the drivers' championship at this weekend's United States Grand Prix. That would make him F1's youngest champion and the first Italian to win the title since Alberto Ascari in 1953.
While speaking during the launch event of the Mercedes United States Grand Prix livery, the 20-year-old explained that his at-home routine includes cleaning his Mercedes-AMG GT63 road car.

"I like to clean my car," Antonelli said. "I never do automatic, you know, with the machine. I always like to wash by hand, myself. Because I love cars, I really like to take care of my car and everything.
"I like to see it clean, so it’s an activity I love to do. It’s a routine."

The United States Grand Prix in Austin, Texas, kicks off the penultimate triple-header of the 2026 season. Mercedes team chief Toto Wolff believes the weekend at the Circuit of the Americas will give the Brackley outfit an opportunity to "respond" after two difficult weekends in Malaysia and Singapore.

"Malaysia and Singapore were difficult weekends for us and we have worked hard to understand where we fell short," Wolff said in the team's United States Grand Prix preview. "Austin gives us an opportunity to respond.

"We will run our latest update package on both cars as we continue to develop the car. The field is incredibly close, so we need to keep moving forward if we want to fight consistently at the front in the closing stages of the season.

"The United States Grand Prix begins another demanding triple-header. There is plenty at stake, but we won’t get ahead of ourselves. The priority is the weekend in front of us: execute well, maximise our performance and take each race as it comes.

"Austin will also be an important weekend for us off track, with a number of commercial activities taking place across the city. At the heart of that will be AMG and the MANUFAKTUR takeover, bringing to life the performance, craftsmanship and individuality of the wider Mercedes family throughout the weekend. We are looking forward to showcasing that and, ultimately, delivering where it matters most: on track."

items.originalTitle: Where to find free F1 fan zones across Austin this week
detailZh: 本周在奥斯汀哪里可以找到免费的F1粉丝区
威廉姆斯、梅赛德斯和红牛等车队将在奥斯汀提供免费体验
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计以及让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
没有本周末美国大奖赛门票的粉丝仍然有很多事情可以做，因为车队和赞助商将在奥斯汀的赛车周期间设立免费的粉丝区，即使没有赛道通行证，你也可以享受其中。
威廉姆斯车队率先开放，其粉丝区位于国会大道800号，从10月19日（星期一）至10月24日（星期六）开放。入场免费，包括展示赛车、赛车模拟器、风洞、威廉姆斯与漫威漫画合作的作品（在这里看看它揭晓的涂装），以及与亚历克斯·阿隆索和车队经理詹姆斯·沃尔斯的问答环节。周四至周六开放时间为上午10点至晚上7点。
阿隆索今天（10月21日，星期三）也将出现在位于东4街的Brazos Hall的杜拉セル动力赛道上。这里由亚马逊运营，设有模拟牛骑、马蹄铁投掷、遥控赛车赛道和现场音乐表演。
今晚，阿斯顿·马丁也与粉红赛道俱乐部合作，在Rainey Street的Bungalow举办了一场免费的女性聚焦F1聚会，包括现场播客录制。
梅赛德斯车队，其车手基米·安东内利可能在周日赢得冠军，将从周四至周日开放其粉丝中心，位于国会大道400号。这里免费提供如维修区挑战、模拟器、每日抽奖和美味的德克萨斯州食品摊贩等服务。
红牛车队本周最为忙碌。该车队及其动力单元合作伙伴福特将今天举办The Pull Up活动，活动内容包括福特Raptor车辆、一辆一级方程式展示车、烧烤和现场音乐，随后从周四到周日，红牛奥斯汀赛车之夜将在东第七街举行。活动包括维修区挑战、模拟器和甚至包括马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈德贾的现场表演。
奥迪在周四于东塞萨尔·查韦斯街的中央机械工厂举办的黑白启动派对免费入场，需提前预约，活动内容包括奥迪展示、出售的艺术品和DJ表演。客人被要求穿着黑白服装……出于某种原因。
车手的个人品牌也来到了这里。兰多·诺里斯的LN4将圣何塞街1500号的加油站变成了一个1970年代风格的车库，用于展示其从今天到周日的新收藏，而丹尼尔·里卡多德的Enchante品牌在周四于分销大厅与福特赛车合作举办了一个快闪店。他甚至可能也会在那里。
小红牛车手利亚姆·劳森将在周四晚上在Inn Cahoots的Esses Bazaar举行他的音乐首秀，尽管位置有限，且需要提前预约。
对于那些愿意付费的人来说，今晚在Long Center举办的Road to the Race超级跑车展览需要支付10美元，而Guenther Steiner将于周六晚上在ACL Live参加《红旗播客》的现场直播。
10月25日星期日下午3点（当地时间）在美洲赛车场举行的比赛。
detailEn: Where to find free F1 fan zones across Austin this week
Williams, Mercedes and Red Bull are among those hosting free experiences across Austin
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Fans without a ticket for this weekend’s United States Grand Prix still have plenty to do, with teams and sponsors setting up free fan zones across Austin during race week for you to enjoy even if you don't have access to the track.

Williams was first to open, with its fan zone at 800 Congress Avenue running from Monday 19 October to Saturday 24 October. Entry is free and includes a show car, racing simulators, a wind tunnel, a Williams x Marvel comic (take a look at the livery it revealed here) and Q&As with Alex Albon and team principal James Vowles. It is open 10am to 7pm Thursday to Saturday.

Albon will also pop up at Duracell’s Power Paddock at Brazos Hall on East 4th Street today (Wednesday 21 October). Run with Amazon, it features a simulated bull ride, a horseshoe toss, an RC race track and live music.
Tonight, Aston Martin also teams up with the Pink Paddock Club for a free women-focused F1 meetup at The Bungalow on Rainey Street, including a live podcast recording.

Mercedes, whose driver Kimi Antonelli could clinch the title on Sunday, opens its fan hub at 400 Congress Avenue from Thursday to Sunday. It is free and offers things such as pitstop challenges, simulators, daily giveaways and tasty Texas food vendors.

Red Bull has the busiest week. The team, along with its power unit partner Ford, will host The Pull Up today, with Ford Raptor vehicles, an F1 show car, a barbecue and live music, before Red Bull Austin Race Nights run from Thursday to Sunday on East Seventh Street. Those include pitstop challenges, simulators and even appearances from Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar.

Audi’s Black & White Kickoff Party on Thursday at Central Machine Works on East Cesar Chavez Street is free with an RSVP, mixing Audi displays, art for sale and DJ sets. Guests are asked to dress in black and white... for some reason.

Drivers’ own brands are in town too. Lando Norris’s LN4 has turned a petrol station at 1500 San Jacinto Boulevard into a 1970s-style garage for its new collection from today until Sunday, while Daniel Ricciardo’s Enchante has a pop-up with Ford Racing at Distribution Hall from Thursday. He might even be there, too.
Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson will make his musical debut at the Esses Bazaar at Inn Cahoots on Thursday evening, although places are limited and RSVPs are necessary.

For those willing to pay, the Road to the Race supercar showcase at the Long Center costs $10 tonight, while Guenther Steiner joins The Red Flags Podcast for a live show at ACL Live on Saturday night.
The race at the Circuit of the Americas starts at 3pm local time on Sunday 25 October.

items.originalTitle: Mercedes F1 unveils dramatic new look for United States Grand Prix
detailZh: 梅赛德斯为美国大奖赛推出全新外观设计
梅赛德斯为2026年美国大奖赛推出独特的蓝色涂装，包括匹配的赛车手赛车服和道路车辆
对于梅赛德斯粉丝来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
梅赛德斯本周末的美国大奖赛将带着这款独一无二的蓝色涂装，因为车队希望其车手安东内利能在周日赢得F1世界冠军
与MANUFAKTUR合作开发，梅赛德斯品牌的个性化项目，设计将W17的常用银色换成了蓝色。汽车的前部真正展示了这种新颜色。
MANUFAKTUR是一项服务，允许梅赛德斯-奔驰、梅赛德斯-AMG和梅赛德斯-迈巴赫的客户通过定制油漆、材料和手工触感来个性化他们的道路车辆。在美国，梅赛德斯销售的约一半汽车都至少选择了MANUFAKTUR的一项特色功能。
除此之外，乔治·拉塞尔将身穿复古蓝色赛车服，安东内利将身穿钢蓝色赛车服，每位车手都将使用一辆与赛车颜色相匹配的梅赛德斯-AMG GT 4门轿跑车。这不是一个糟糕的额外奖励。车队在美洲赛车场的维修区也将进行MANUFAKTUR改造。
为了进一步庆祝涂装，将在南国会、艾米餐厅、特科瓦斯、W酒店和SCHEELS举行活动，而其免费的粉丝中心将于周四在400国会大道开放。
“Austin也将是我们赛道外的一个重要周末，整个城市将举办多项商业活动，”车队负责人Toto Wolff在车队预告中表示。“其中最重要的是AMG和MANUFAKTUR的接管，整个周末将展现梅赛德斯家族的性能、工艺和个性。”
“这是梅赛德斯在三次比赛中使用的第二种特别涂装。在三次比赛前的Sepang，车队通过交换其银色和青色的位置来庆祝与Petronas的冠军合作伙伴关系。”
“美国大奖赛开始了另一个要求严格的连续三站赛事，”Wolff指出。“有很多事情要处理，但我们不会过于乐观。我们的首要任务是眼前的周末：执行得很好，最大化我们的表现，并按部就班地对待每一场比赛。”
detailEn: Mercedes F1 unveils dramatic new look for United States Grand Prix
Mercedes has unveiled a striking blue livery for the 2026 United States Grand Prix, complete with matching driver race suits and road cars
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes is heading to this weekend's United States Grand Prix with a one-off blue livery as the team hopes that its driver Kimi Antonelli will clinch the Formula 1 world championship on Sunday.
Developed with MANUFAKTUR, the Mercedes brand's personalisation programme, the design swaps the W17’s usual silver for blue. The nose of the car really shows off the new colour.

MANUFAKTUR is the service that lets Mercedes-Benz, Mercedes-AMG and Mercedes-Maybach customers personalise their road cars with bespoke paint, materials and handcrafted touches. About half of the cars Mercedes sells in the US are ordered with at least one MANUFAKTUR feature.

On top of this, George Russell will wear a vintage blue race suit and Antonelli a steel blue one, and each driver will use a Mercedes-AMG GT 4-Door Coupe finished to match. Not a bad bonus. The team’s garage at the Circuit of the Americas will also get a MANUFAKTUR makeover.
To further celebrate the paint job, activations are planned at South Congress, Amy’s, Tecovas, the W Hotel and SCHEELS, while its free fan hub opens at 400 Congress Avenue from Thursday.

“Austin will also be an important weekend for us off track, with a number of commercial activities taking place across the city,” team principal Toto Wolff said in the team's preview. “At the heart of that will be AMG and the MANUFAKTUR takeover, bringing to life the performance, craftsmanship and individuality of the wider Mercedes family throughout the weekend.”

It is the second special livery Mercedes has run in three races. Two races ago at Sepang, the team celebrated its title partnership with Petronas by swapping the positions of its silver and turquoise.

"The United States Grand Prix begins another demanding triple-header," Wolff notes. "There is plenty at stake, but we won’t get ahead of ourselves. The priority is the weekend in front of us: execute well, maximise our performance and take each race as it comes."

一级方程式车队和车手们正在拥抱德克萨斯州的氛围，为2026年美国大奖赛做准备
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
美国大奖赛是少数几个几乎每个车队都会有所庆祝的赛事之一。一级方程式巡回赛本周末抵达德克萨斯州，让我们来盘点一下车队带来的丹宁牛仔装、牛仔帽和西部风格的商品。
奥斯汀自豪地展示着来自红牛、凯迪拉克、威廉姆斯、维斯塔潘和兰多·诺里斯本人的收藏，甚至连F1也带来了自己的装备。
红牛全力以赴，因为它的引擎合作伙伴福特在美国赛车场为其主场赛事而疯狂地推出了Raptor系列。车队将穿着由Raptor和美国西部启发的Castore系列赛车服、靴子、夹克和衬衫。车手维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈德贾本周末将身穿白色赛车服，以庆祝这一场合。
“奥斯汀总是个充满乐趣的周末，”红牛商业总监保罗·甘多菲说。“今年，我们将比以往任何时候都要更大规模，无论是在赛道上还是在整个城市。”
福特赛车总经理威尔·福特补充说：“我们非常喜欢ORBR车队对Raptor精神的拥抱，从赛车服到维修区。”
红牛和新时代公司还推出了一款深红色带有奶油色帽檐的奥斯汀帽子，上面印有维斯塔潘的3号和哈吉尔的6号。
维斯塔潘的狮子头戴牛仔帽，出现在他独一无二的奥斯汀头盔上，同样的主题也出现在他自己的‘释放狮子奥斯汀’系列中，其中包括一件上面印有牛仔狮子和‘奥斯汀，德克萨斯州’字样的87美元连帽衫。头盔的复制品从93美元的1:4比例模型开始销售。
哈斯车队将奥斯汀视为其最重要的主场赛事，转而选择了哥斯拉。作为其与日本工作室东宝长期合作的一部分，车队于周一公布了以哥斯拉为主题的涂装，埃斯蒂班·奥康和奥利弗·贝尔曼将身穿配套的赛车服。19日，车队系列帽衫和车手T恤衫开始销售，同时还有海报和拼图。从10月23日至25日，粉丝可以在巴顿克里克广场购物中心看到哥斯拉展示车并购买该系列商品。还有一款55美元的新时代奥斯汀帽子。
‘通过推出续集涂装，我们在一级方程式赛场上开辟了新的领域，这是我们非常自豪的，’哈斯车队负责人小松英昭说。
凯迪拉克的Austin胶囊系列源自其与Tommy Hilfiger的合作，并于10月13日开始销售。该系列包括售价321美元的浅色水洗牛仔夹克，一件带有银色箔面涂层的女士牛仔背心，一件T恤，一件背心，以及售价74美元的牛仔帽，紧随迈阿密和墨西哥胶囊系列。拉斯维加斯版预计将在11月上市。
‘我们从Tommy衣橱的标志性单品开始设计’，Tommy Hilfiger首席设计官Lee Holman说道。
威廉姆斯车队今年将装备供应商改为New Era，推出了Austin赛车系列，包括售价180美元的牛仔夹克，售价85美元的牛仔帽，牛仔司机帽和印有‘Austin, TX’和‘Est. 1977’的西部风格T恤。
梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪则保持了简洁的风格，推出了特别版的adidas Austin帽，每顶售价61美元。
诺里斯的LN4品牌走了一条不同的路线。兰多的原始服务部门是一个由12件套组成的系列，灵感来源于70年代的赛车车库，从奥斯汀市中心的一个改造后的加油站出售，直到周日。
F1的自己的系列包括一个如你所见带有NAHMIAS的收藏。轮胎供应商倍耐力还提供一款售价94美元的奥斯汀领奖台帽子。
美国大奖赛将于10月23日至25日在美国赛车场举行。
detailEn: F1 teams reveal special United States GP collections with denim, cowboy hats and Godzilla
Formula 1 teams and drivers are embracing the spirit of Texas for the 2026 United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

The United States Grand Prix is one of the few races where almost every team will do something to celebrate. The Formula 1 circus arrives in Texas this weekend, so let's do a roundup of the denim, cowboy hats and Western-styled merchandise the teams have brought with them.
Austin is proudly showing off collections from Red Bull, Cadillac, Williams, Max Verstappen and Lando Norris themselves, and even F1 has brought its own kit.

Red Bull has gone all out as its engine partner, Ford, goes Raptor crazy at the Circuit of the Americas for its home race. The team will be wearing a Castore collection of race suits, boots, jackets and shirts inspired by the Raptor and the American West. Drivers Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar will be wearing white race suits this weekend to celebrate the occasion.
“Austin is always a weekend where we have a lot of fun,” said Red Bull commercial director Paul Gandolfi. “This year, we’re going bigger than ever, both at the circuit and across the city.”
Ford Racing general manager Will Ford added: "We love how the ORBR team has embraced the spirit of Raptor, from the race suits to the pit garages."
Red Bull and New Era have also produced an Austin cap in maroon with a cream peak, carrying Verstappen’s No. 3 and Hadjar’s No. 6.

Verstappen’s lion wears a cowboy hat on his one-off Austin helmet, and the same theme features in his own Unleash the Lion Austin collection, which includes an $87 hoodie with the cowboy lion above the words “Austin, Texas”. Replicas of the helmet start at $93 for a 1:4 scale model.

Haas, which considers Austin its biggest home race, has turned to Godzilla. As part of its season-long partnership with Japanese studio TOHO, the team revealed a Godzilla-themed livery on Monday, and Esteban Ocon and Oliver Bearman will wear matching race suits. A collection of team hoodies and driver T-shirts went on sale on 19 October, alongside posters and jigsaw puzzles. Fans can see a Godzilla show car and buy the range at Barton Creek Square mall from 23 to 25 October. There is also a $55 New Era Austin cap.
“We’re breaking new ground in Formula 1 by launching a sequel livery, and it’s something we’re very proud of,” said Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu.

Cadillac’s Austin capsule stems from its partnership with Tommy Hilfiger, and went on sale on 13 October. It includes a light-wash denim jacket at $321, a women’s denim vest with a silver foil coating, a T-shirt, a tank top and a $74 denim cap, and follows capsules for Miami and Mexico. A Las Vegas edition is due in November.
“We started with icons of the Tommy wardrobe,” said Tommy Hilfiger chief design officer Lee Holman.

Williams, which changed to New Era as its kit supplier this year, has an Austin race collection with a $180 denim jacket, an $85 cowboy hat, denim trucker caps and T-shirts with Western-style lettering reading “Austin, TX” and “Est. 1977”.
Mercedes and Audi have kept it easy, with special edition adidas Austin caps at $61 each.

Norris’s LN4 brand has gone down a different route. Lando’s Original Service Department is a 12-piece collection inspired by 1970s racing garages, sold from a converted petrol station in downtown Austin until Sunday.
F1’s own range includes a collection with NAHMIAS as you can see below. Tyre supplier Pirelli also has a $94 Austin podium cap.
The United States Grand Prix takes place at the Circuit of the Americas from 23 to 25 October.
